title: Lost Mary Maryliq Pineapple Mango 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Take your taste buds on a tropical getaway with Lost Mary Maryliq's Pineapple Mango e-liquid. The rich, juicy Pineapple marries perfectly with the succulent Mango, delivering a flavour experience that's nothing short of paradisiacal. Each puff is a mini-vacation, transporting you to sun-drenched beaches and exotic locales. The 50% VG / 50% PG ratio ensures a balanced vape, offering a smooth throat hit and flavourful clouds that capture the essence of this tropical duo.
